[38;5;29m│ [0m[38;5;205m! [0mDimensions are standard ISO: 20' = 6.06 × 2.44 m, 40' = 12.19 ×   [38;5;29m │[0m
[38;5;29m│ [0m  2.44 m, high-cube 2.90 m tall. Bay counts, areas, and the manifest[38;5;29m │[0m
[38;5;29m│ [0m  are computed from those figures.                                  [38;5;29m │[0m
[38;5;29m│ [0m                                                                    [38;5;29m │[0m
[38;5;29m│ [0m[38;5;205m! [0mStacking: ISO corner castings and posts carry the loads at sea, so[38;5;29m │[0m
[38;5;29m│ [0m  intact boxes stack corner-on-corner. Every opening cut into a wall[38;5;29m │[0m
[38;5;29m│ [0m  reduces that; the tall layouts here are design examples, and any  [38;5;29m │[0m
[38;5;29m│ [0m  real build gets an engineer.                                      [38;5;29m │[0m
[38;5;29m│ [0m                                                                    [38;5;29m │[0m
[38;5;29m│ [0m[38;5;205m! [0mBuried / bermed: container walls are not designed for lateral soil[38;5;29m │[0m
[38;5;29m│ [0m  load. An earth-sheltered unit needs a retaining structure,        [38;5;29m │[0m
[38;5;29m│ [0m  membrane waterproofing, and drainage. It is the one option that   [38;5;29m │[0m
[38;5;29m│ [0m  changes the box.                                                  [38;5;29m │[0m
[38;5;29m│ [0m                                                                    [38;5;29m │[0m
[38;5;29m│ [0m[38;5;205m! [0mThis page is a configurator, not a quotation. Costs, delivery, and[38;5;29m │[0m
[38;5;29m│ [0m  site work depend on the ground you are standing on.               [38;5;29m │[0m
